summary: Frontend-only verification on the full Operations DashboardPage of: (1) CRITICAL Log-a-Fault dialog no longer closes on Machine Type selection, (2) Equipment-detail → Log-a-fault pre-fills Machine Type + Serial, (3) AI Fault Diagnosis quick action opens Log-a-Fault dialog (no blank tab), (4) Gym Health Score gauge label sits below the donut, (5) KPI sparklines + trend badges render on stat-issues/audits/tasks, (6) Expenses queue pills have visible contrast. All 6 scenarios PASS as logged in as owner@isodemo.com on the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

issues: Active pill (desk-exp-queue-submitted 'To review') uses bg=rgb(14,116,144) brand-cyan with text-color=rgb(24,24,27) zinc-900. Contrast ratio ≈ 4.0:1 — readable but just below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text. PRD said 'active pill is brand-blue with white text'; implementation uses brand-cyan with dark text. Core regression (washed-out white-on-white) is fixed; this is a minor deviation worth a follow-up review.

tests_executed.details: Faults → Log a Fault opens issue-dialog. issue-type-select is now a native <SELECT> with options ['','Life Fitness Treadmill','Precor Elliptical']. After page.select_option('Life Fitness Treadmill') the dialog remained open (issue-dialog count=1, value='Life Fitness Treadmill'). Datalist serial 'ISO-TM-001' surfaced and was set. CRITICAL bug (Radix Select inside Dialog closing on option click) is FIXED.

Equipment → Details (Life Fitness Treadmill) → lite-equip-log-fault closes details and opens issue-dialog with issue-type-select.value='Life Fitness Treadmill' AND issue-serial-select.value='ISO-TM-001'. Both pre-filled.
Dashboard subtab → Quick Actions → quick-action-diagnosis click opens issue-dialog (count=1). URL remains /dashboard — no navigation to a blank 'diagnosis' tab.

Gym Health Score card renders score '38' (centered in donut) with rating label 'Needs Attention' sitting below the SVG donut, no overlap. Visually confirmed in dashboard screenshot (iter_dashboard_full.png).

Dashboard subtab shows 3 KPI cards all with kpi-sparkline (3) + kpi-trend-badge (3). Card text examples: 'Open Faults 8 ▲ 100% Apr May Jun', 'Audits Completed 0 – 0% Apr May Jun', 'Maintenance Tasks 34 – 0% Apr May Jun'. Numbers + 3 month labels + % badges all render.

Operations → Staffing → Expenses shows 2 pills. desk-exp-queue-submitted (active) bg=rgb(14,116,144) text=rgb(24,24,27); desk-exp-queue-approved (inactive) bg=rgb(244,244,245) text=rgb(24,24,27) border=rgb(196,196,204). Pills are clearly visible (not washed white-on-white). See design_issues for minor active-pill contrast follow-up.

action_items: (Optional) Active expenses queue pill (desk-exp-queue-submitted) uses brand-cyan + zinc-900 text (~4.0:1 contrast). PRD says 'brand-blue + white text' — consider switching to white text or brand-blue for stricter WCAG AA compliance.

(Carryover from previous iter) Both issue-dialog and equipment-details-dialog still emit Radix `Missing Description or aria-describedby` warnings — silence with aria-describedby={undefined} or add DialogDescription for accessibility cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: FaultDialogs.js L149-161: Native <select> for Machine Type with onKeyDown stopPropagation correctly mirrors the already-fixed serial input pattern — solid resolution to the Radix-Select-inside-Dialog portal-close bug.

OverviewTab.js sparkline implementation is client-side computed from issues/audits/tasks; trend % shows '– 0%' for empty 3-month windows (correct neutral state), and '▲ 100%' for stat-issues — verify the formula handles the 0→N case gracefully (rendered fine in test, just flagging).
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! — full operations DashboardPage, theme-gymaxis light.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing iso-demo-site-a seed: Life Fitness Treadmill (ISO-TM-001) + Precor Elliptical + 8 open PH3-* faults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 fixes confirmed working on https://multi-eng-booking.preview.emergentagent.com via owner@isodemo.com. Operations dashboard has sub-tabs (Start, Dashboard, Equipment, Faults, Check Sheets, Documents, Staffing, Reports, Suppliers, Gym Layout). KPI cards + Gym Health gauge + Quick Actions all live on the 'Dashboard' SUB-tab (not Start). Expenses pills live at Operations → Staffing → Expenses. issue-type-select is a NATIVE <select>; use page.select_option() instead of Radix click sequences. issue-serial-select is a native input + datalist (#issue-serial-datalist). Existing-fault warning fires when serial matches an open fault — may toggle dialog wrapper DOM but the dialog itself stays mounted (CRITICAL behavior preserved).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug RCA (already fixed by main agent): Radix UI Select component renders options in a portal; clicking an option emitted a pointerdown that the parent Radix Dialog treated as 'interact-outside' and closed itself. Fix: replaced Radix Select for Machine Type with native HTML <select>, mirroring the prior serial-input fix. Verified: dialog stays open after select_option.
